notes: This is the SAME app already used for the existing 947-verse Kannada ingestion at dge/data/dasa_sahitya/dasakuta/jagannathadasa/harikathamrutasara/data.json (confirmed via matching string-array resource names). That ingestion's source_meta claims 'No verse-level meaning exists in this source' -- this is INCORRECT for 3 of the 33 sandhis: sandhis 1, 26, and 27 have real content in the app's default (non-Kannada) locale config -- romanized (IAST-style) verse text interleaved with genuine per-verse word-by-word glosses ('word = meaning' style) and extended prose commentary, not placeholder text. The other 30 sandhis are empty in this locale, so the original claim holds for those. NOT MERGED into the ingested data.json: the raw text has no clean machine-parseable boundary between one verse's meaning/commentary block and the next verse's romanized restatement of its own text (both appear in the same run-on stream, separated only by the '|| N ||' verse-end marker that starts the meaning block, not by anything marking where it ends) -- attempting an automatic split risks misattributing a commentary paragraph to the wrong verse. A careful manual or heavily-supervised pass is needed before this becomes part of the corpus. See dge/PENDING.md 11 Sep 2026 entry.
